segments.text: The "fake" Lord Shin'nai. In reality he's Chiemi's grandfather and the previous head of the Miguruma family.
The only police officer in the whole of Fujiyoshi.
His rough exterior hides a sensitive and kind person, with childlike innocence regarding romantic stories.
He works for Higuchi Shouji.
Occupation: Graduate Student
Stay as: Visitor

After a motorbike accident in the middle of the forest, Haruaki arrives in the settlement of Yasumizu. At first sight, he appears to be a well-behaved young man—but there is more to him than meets the eye.
For reasons unknown, Haruaki loops back in time after his death, only to re-live his life from the day of the 11th of May over again.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: College Student
Stay as: Returnee
With a friendly and sociable personality, Chiemi is a college student that returned to her hometown of Fujiyoshi. She is the first person that Haruaki encounters upon his arrival.
Chiemi lives in room 202 of the student dorm.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Priestess
Stay as: Dweller
Rikako is the head of the Uematsu household, one of the chief families in Fujiyoshi Village.
As a priestess, she recounts the legends and traditions of Fujiyoshi.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Student
Stay as: Dweller
Haru is a shy, high school student from Fujiyoshi. She can be a little ambiguous in her manner, sometimes saying things that no one understands.
Haru is Kanzo's granddaughter, and lives in room 201 of the student dorm.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Student
Stay as: Dweller
Yasunaga is a high school student with a highly analytical mind. He is the leader of the group of Yasumizu high schoolers.
He is Kaori's son and Yoshitsugu's brother, currently living in room 102 of the student dorm.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Student
Stay as: Dweller
Another high schooler from the village of Fujiyoshi, Chikamochi has an odd and playful personality. He follows his instincts and this natural intuition is often proven right.
He lives in room 101 of the student dorm.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Farmer
Stay as: Dweller
Takumi is an easy person to talk to who does all sorts of manual work around Yasumizu.
He lives in the house near the plaza of Yasumizu.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Cook
Stay as: Dweller
A resident of the village of Fujiyoshi, Kaori is in charge of the dining hall in Yasumizu.
She is a calm person but can be rather strict with her children, Yasunaga and Yoshitsugu.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Truant
Stay as: Dweller
Yoshitsugu is a rebellious middle school student who often skips class and looks for trouble.
He is Kaori's son and Yasunaga's younger brother, living near the dining hall.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Journalist
Stay as: Guest
A woman from Kanto, Hisako is a freelance writer who travels across Japan in search of local culinary specialties.
She works with Yuudai and stays at the lodge in Kamifujiyoshi.
Modified from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Photographer
Stay as: Guest
A renowned photographer from Kanto who looks like a giant and works with Hisako. People often find Yuudai mysterious due to his taciturn attitude at work.
He stays at the lodge in Kamifujiyoshi.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: None
Stay as: Sojourner
Kiyonosuke is a resident of the village of Fujiyoshi and the second son of the Nosato family. He has a background in medical studies, but hasn't had a steady job over the past few years.
He returned to Yasumizu recently and lives in the family mansion.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Farmer
Stay as: Dweller
A resident of the village of Fujiyoshi who works in the fields. Tae is superstitious, and not always friendly towards newcomers.
She lives in a house located near the rice fields.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: Hunter
Stay as: Dweller
A resident of the village of Fujiyoshi, Kanzo is a strong-willed and charismatic figure.
He hunts wild boars and deers, and lives in a house next to the plaza of Yasumizu.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Occupation: None
Stay as: Stray
This young girl was discovered abandoned by the Saranaga Rapids, which led the most of the Yasumizu inhabitants to be wary of her.
She has been given the nickname "Meiko" simply because no one knows her real name. She often cries "Baa!".
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
Her real identity is the Black Goat from the Pasture Project. She later grows up to become Miyo Tougo in Death Match Love Comedy.
Occupation: None
Age: Unknown
Stay as: Dweller
This resident lives in a house near the graveyard of Yasumizu, spending most of his time scaring fellow neighbors with false prophecies that warn that the wolves are on their way.
This behavior has earned him the nickname "The Old Man Who Cried Wolf". Though perhaps one day soon, his mad ramblings may be proven true.
Taken from the official art book included with the Day One Edition.
His real name is Kida Tokuji. He was a mass murderer during World War II.
A rude and cranky clerk working at the convenience store Fresh Marke which Haruaki visits on the way to Kamifujiyoshi.
Her name is Mitsuji Misamine and she was the ex-girlfriend whom Haruaki was trying to run away from.

She is a dreamweaver like Rikako, and she appears in the form of a floating goat when helping Haruaki within Rikako's looping dream and is also the same goat the reader encounters upon reading through bad endings. She's often called by the nickname Sheep (Hitsuji).
Survivor of the Salvation Pasture Project.
